title: The Shape of the DPO Hyperparameter Landscape: What to Measure, How It Moves with Scale, and When Not to Transfer It
abstract: arXiv:2610.27895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct preference optimisation (DPO) is widely used for language model post-training, but its performance depends strongly on the choice of its hyperparameters, such as the learning rate and the reference-policy regularisation parameter $\beta$. To better understand the DPO hyperparameter landscape, we conduct extensive experiments using a dense hyperparameter grid across different model scales from the same family. This allows us to analyse how the optimal DPO hyperparameters evolve with model size and the number of update steps, with intermediate checkpoints providing an inexpensive signal to accelerate the hyperparameter optimisation process. Furthermore, by evaluating our models on both static and dynamic benchmarks, we identify which benchmarks provide the strongest signal for hyperparameter selection. translated_title: DPO超参数空间的全貌：测量什么、如何随规模变化、以及何时不应迁移
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化被广泛用于语言模型的后训练，但其性能在很大程度上取决于超参数的选择，例如学习率和参考策略正则化参数β。为了更好地理解DPO超参数空间，我们使用密集的超参数网格，在来自同一系列的不同模型规模上开展了大量实验。这使我们能够分析最优DPO超参数如何随模型大小和更新步数的演变而变化，其中中间检查点提供了一种低成本的信号，可用于加速超参数优化过程。此外，通过在静态和动态基准上评估我们的模型，我们确定了哪些基准能为超参数选择提供最强的信号。最后，我们研究了多种最先进的超参数优化策略在此设置下的表现。
tldr: 通过密集超参数网格实验系统描绘了DPO超参数空间随模型规模和训练步数的演变规律，并识别了最适合超参数选择的基准与优化策略。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically maps the DPO hyperparameter landscape across model scales using dense grid experiments, revealing how optimal hyperparameters evolve with size and training steps, and identifying which benchmarks and optimization strategies best guide hyperparameter selection.
